svg.text: The FoldX channel — physics pipeline, two arms, one head slot
Two arms feed one head slot. The channel is computed once from structure, so it is reused unchanged across every PLM backbone and every split.
FoldX — the physics side, no learning
SKEMPI crystal complex · two interface chain groups
one-time per structure (~3 min) · 211 already on disk
side-chain repack → mutant PDB · ~8 s per mutation
run on the wild-type and on the mutant
The 12 terms — each a ΔΔG in kcal/mol, mutant − wild-type:
Term 1 is the scalar Arm A uses — Arm B strictly contains Arm A.
Names as emitted by FoldX AnalyseComplex.
H + 1 — identical for both arms; the regression head is unchanged.
Everything left of the slot is the published sequence-only model.
Model-independent physics: reused across 10 backbones × 9 split tiers, no re-run.
The channel adds one input, not a new pathway.
The two arms — one slot, two producers
The head learns one additional weight

arm that clears FoldX-alone on ESM-C 6B.
